text:
maria: heads-up — canary for r3456 (autobatch + kernel-router) shows a steady mem growth trend over the last 6h, spikes on long ctxs. saw ~12% heap growth/hour, evict pressure rising :warning:

aj: ugh. saw the grafana panel, looks like slab usage climbing. any OOMs yet? link: https://grafana.company/d/srv/canary-autobatch?from=now-12h

maria: not OOMs on canary yet but I have a local repro. running a longctx harness (seqlen ~8k) hits OOM in kv_slab_alloc. snippet from the log: ```
[2026-03-17T18:02:11Z] runtime: kv_alloc: slab=12 used=98% free=2% evict_cycle=130ms
[2026-03-17T18:02:11Z] runtime: triggering aggressive_eviction
[2026-03-17T18:02:12Z] runtime: allocation failed -> OOM
```

devon: can you attach a pprof or flame? my hunch: the autobatch prefetch path is making hot slabs hotter and preventing compaction cycles.

maria: attaching quick flame excerpt inline: ```
# top of cpu profile
kv_alloc -> 42%
slab_rotate -> 28%
autobatch_prefetch -> 18%
copy_kv_entries -> 12%
```
shows slab_rotate and autobatch_prefetch dominating.

alia: r3456 added optimistic prefetch for autobatch to reduce latency (PR 3456). it preloads likely-hot slab entries at request time — if prefetch frequency is too high that could starve compaction windows. saw similar behavior in a spike test last year.

aj: ok let's bisect the deploy range r3400..r3460. devon, can you run a fast binary bisect using the canary image snapshots?

devon: starting bisect job now, spinning up toggled canaries with/without r3456. pinging @ci-bot so artifacts are captured.

ci-bot: Job started: jog-bisect-1765432100. Artifacts and perf traces will be uploaded at: https://ci.company/builds/1765432100

devon: bisect complete — failure pins to r3456. locally repros with image built at r3456: mem-slope + occasional OOMs. revert to r3455 clears the slope immediately.

maria: we should hold rollout. longctx customers will be hit in production. recommend revert.

aj: agreed. @deploy-bot please pause rollout for r3456 and create revert.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for r3456. Revert created as r3457: https://deploys.company/changes/3457 (actioned)

sam: filing a perf incident (INC-2026-034) and adding notes for standup. I'll also add a targeted regression test that simulates sustained longctx KV pressure to CI.

maria: follow-ups: 1) add kv slab compaction smoke + longctx stress to CI (fast), 2) add a perf check that fails if slab_rotation CPU > 15% on canary, 3) tweak prefetch backoff for autobatch or gate it behind runtime config. tagging memory owners @alia @devon for the remediation plan. :memo:
